WHO Antenatal Care Guideline Implementation Guide, published by World Health Organization (WHO). This guide is not an authorized publication; it is the continuous build for version 0.3.0 built by the FHIR (HL7® FHIR® Standard) CI Build. This version is based on the current content of https://github.com/WorldHealthOrganization/smart-anc/tree/master and changes regularly. See the Directory of published versions
Built from commit 30ed8736.

SUSHI Conversion Field-Level Diff

SUSHI conversion: field-level diff

Every difference between each original resource (before the conversion, git commit 6f13549) and the JSON SUSHI now generates. Back to the summary.

Resources not listed here are identical to their originals (all 623 value sets, 56 libraries, 37 plan definitions, 17 activity definitions, 12 questionnaires, 10 measures, 6 concept maps, 1 device, 1 operation definition, and 12 examples).

Profiles and extensions (354)

"same" means the rule is unchanged in the SUSHI snapshot; "CHANGED" rows are the ones listed under semantic changes on the summary page.
